title: Generational Fandom: How Lucknow Super Giants Is Passed Down in Families
dek: Lucknow Super Giants are still a young franchise. How long the story has run decides whether fandom can be passed down yet.
excerpt: Lucknow Super Giants have played only a few seasons, so their fandom is still first-generation. Their history is being written by the fans who chose them.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: LSG first played in 2022: {{ev:gf-age}} years and {{ev:gf-n-seasons}} seasons of history.
They have used {{ev:gf-avg}} players a season on average, {{ev:gf-total}} player-seasons in all.
That is too short a history for fandom to have passed between generations yet.

sections.heading: Inherited Loyalty
body: In older sports, supporting a club is often inherited: a parent's team becomes a child's. The IPL is young enough that this is only beginning.
The CricField warehouse holds no survey, sentiment or social-media data, so it cannot measure what fans feel. It can measure what they have watched.

sections.heading: How Long the Story Has Run
body: Lucknow Super Giants first played in 2022: {{ev:gf-age}} years and {{ev:gf-n-seasons}} seasons of history. Their fans are still the generation that chose them.
Across that time the franchise has used {{ev:gf-avg}} players a season on average, {{ev:gf-total}} player-seasons in all. The chart shows how many players each season used.

sections.heading: What Gets Passed Down
body: What families pass on is usually a set of shared memories: a final, a favourite player, a home ground. The franchise's archive is that inheritance.

sections.heading: Building for the Next Generation
body: Junior memberships, family stands and school programmes are the usual ways clubs turn one generation's loyalty into the next.
Measuring their effect would need membership data by age over many seasons.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: A First-Generation Fan Base
body: Lucknow Super Giants have a first-generation fan base. Shared memories from these early seasons will be what the next generation inherits.
Whether it is actually being passed on needs survey data to show.
